name: nvim
description: Private Codex plugin for Neovim issue investigation, worktree, and verification workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Neovim issue, worktree, verification, and edit-window workflows
interface.longDescription: Private Neovim workflows for Codex sessions: fetch GitHub issue context with gh, create isolated upstream worktrees, run history investigation, run bounded Spark reproduction as a separate stage, verify changes, and populate the mux edit Neovim window from natural-language file targets.
defaultPrompt: Investigate Neovim issue #12345 without proposing fixes
Reproduce Neovim issue #12345 with the configured Spark strategy
Create a Neovim issue worktree and write the report
Populate the edit window with the relevant mux command files
